fusions.name: Between the Ribs
fusions.desc: A hidden slit that deals 8 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times the damage they had left. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Flung Cleaver
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach of 6 tiles, and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Muffled Hooves
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Edge Kept Ready
fusions.desc: When you kill something, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
